about: Machine-readable fixture for Atlas GET /travel/legs. Prose: docs/lanes/travel-legs-contract.md. Schema: travel-legs-1.schema.json. Every requestErrors and notFound case is reproduced exactly by src/api/travelLegsContract.test.ts; every example is replayed through routeLegs by the same test. No coordinate, walking time or drive time here is synthetic: the routed example is one live openrouteservice answer (2026-10-11 17:32 UTC); the failure example came from a local stub provider and says so.

otherMethods.note: POST is a 405: the route exists. Do not read 405 as endpoint-absent.

Atlas holds no Discovery candidate not-a-candidate.

notFound.means: A stop id is stale or wrong (merged, retired, never a candidate). The whole request fails. It is NOT an unavailable route, NOT an unrouted stop, and NOT an absent endpoint. Branch on code === 'unknown-stops'; a path that does not exist answers {"error":"Not found"} with no code.

estimated.passport: Show minutes and road km, the attribution (last limitations item), and accessCaution when present. If areaPoint is true the route goes to a point inside a park/beach/trail, not its entrance: never present the minutes as time to the way in.

unavailable.passport: No route: the provider answered and could not route this leg. Show because and a labelled straight line.

unavailableTransient.passport: Temporary: the provider did not answer. Says nothing about the route. Show 'couldn't check just now', back off ≥60 s, never hide or rank down the stop.

unrouted.passport: Atlas holds no point of its own for a stop (unknown, conflicting, or no coordinates). Not malformed, not retryable until data changes.

distinguish.what: stop id not a Discovery candidate
stop has no point Atlas holds

distinguish.wire: 200, leg travel.state 'unavailable', transient true, top-level failure

distinguish.what: no provider or mode not routed
route to an area's interior point
distinguish.wire: 200, leg estimated with areaPoint true and accessCaution starting with AREA_POINT_CAUTION; total.areaPoints when summed

areaPointCaution: Atlas holds no entrance, parking or trailhead for this area: its point is somewhere inside it (often a map centroid), so the route goes to wherever the road network reaches that point, not to where a visitor parks

quota.costPerCall: at most 1 provider request; 0 when cached; unrouted legs cost nothing
